## Wave 3 Summary

Wave 3 is the cross-cluster wave of Investigation-4 (the GR / black-hole-thermodynamics cluster). It carries the two seed items that bridge the wave-1 thermodynamic vantage and the wave-2 geometric vantage rather than sitting inside either. **INV4-W3-1** (compute, hawking-authored) develops the de Sitter static-patch first law `dE = −T_dS dS_dS` on the `a₀` channel and tests whether it reduces to the Volovik tracking law `ρ_vac ∼ M_Pl²H²` — putting the cosmological expansion clock in `a₀` (where Λ lives) rather than the volume-preserving `a₂` channel (where `G_N` lives and must stay τ-flat), thereby attempting to unify the missing-`a(t)` gap (G2) with the CC tracking law (C10) under one horizon-thermodynamic relation, and sidestepping the C2 conformal-clock tension. **INV4-W3-2** (workshop, sp ↔ lizzi, 2 rounds) is the one genuine Q1a adversarial item the surveys produced: the geometric reading (homogeneity degree vs apex dimension `d_spec_cone_apex=8`) and the spectral reading (regulator class / functional select / pole index) compete to predict whether a substrate-IS bridge-map observable's finite-L Level-3 magnitude CONVERGES or DIVERGES — converting the recurring string of HELD-Level-3 rows (§VII.AU, §VII.CB, S109) into a predictive wall plus a decisive forward gate.

The two items are **complementary, not adversarial** to each other (W3-1 is the `a₀`-channel clock; the wave-2 Raychaudhuri gate W2-2 is the `a₂`/invariant-focusing reading; a divergence between them would seed a FUTURE workshop NOT planned this round — see honest-count note in the seed). The wave's gate-type mix is **compute×1 + workshop×1**.

| Gate ID | gate_type | Scope |
|:--------|:----------|:------|
| INV4-W3-1 | compute | de Sitter static-patch first law `dE = −T_dS dS_dS` on `a₀`; show it IS the Volovik tracking law `ρ_vac ∼ M_Pl²H²`; clock in `a₀` (sidesteps C2), unifying G2 (a(t)) with C10 (CC tracking) |
| INV4-W3-2 | workshop | sp ↔ lizzi (2 rounds): which property predicts convergent-vs-divergent finite-L Level-3 magnitude — geometric (homogeneity degree vs apex dim `d_spec_cone_apex=8`) vs spectral (regulator class / functional select / pole index) |

## Wave 3 Decision Point Prerequisites

- **INV4-W3-1 (compute)** consumes only PERMANENT/canonical inputs (`w0_FW`, `A_horizon_FW`, `a2_fold`, the `S97-DS-AREA-LAW-MONOTONICITY` INFO seed, `ρ_vac/ρ_obs = 1.032`). It has **no intra-wave prerequisite** — it is independently dispatchable at wave start. It does NOT consume any wave-1 or wave-2 verdict.
- **INV4-W3-2 (workshop)** consumes only landed/registered artifacts (`S109-VIICB-ZETA-NATIVE-LEVEL-3` FAIL verdict, §VII.AU + §VII.CB registry entries, `cross-pillar-bridge-anatomy.md` 3-level ladder, the sp survey C-3/R-3). It has **no intra-wave prerequisite** on INV4-W3-1 (the de Sitter clock and the Level-3 divergence are independent substrate-physics questions). Both gates may dispatch in parallel.
- If `S109-VIICB-ZETA-NATIVE-LEVEL-3` cannot be located in `computations/session-109/s109_gate_verdicts.txt` at dispatch, the workshop still proceeds (its sources include the §VII.AU/§VII.CB registry entries and the 3-level ladder independently); the missing verdict is noted, not blocking.

# (7) substitution_chain — MANDATORY ([SIGN] trigger on the de Sitter first-law sign)
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "dE = −T_dS dS_dS (de Sitter sign): adding static-patch matter energy
            E>0 DECREASES the cosmological-horizon entropy S_dS; equivalently
            S_dS INCREASES as Λ (∝ a₀) DECREASES."

    Definition 1: Λ  = cosmological constant ∝ a₀ / vol  [a₀ = zeroth Seeley-DeWitt
                       moment, the vacuum-energy moment; phononic-framing.md: Λ IS the
                       a₀ spectral moment, DISTINCT from a₂ (which gives G_N).]
    Definition 2: R_H = √(3/Λ)              [de Sitter horizon radius, Gibbons-Hawking;
                       corpus: R_H = √(3/Λ).]
    Definition 3: A   = 4π R_H²             [horizon area.]
    Definition 4: S_dS = A / (4G)           [Gibbons-Hawking entropy; corpus equation
                       S_dS = 3π/(Λ ℓ_P²) = A_horizon/4G.]
    Definition 5: T_dS = H / (2π), H = √(Λ/3)  [Gibbons-Hawking temperature.]
    Definition 6: first law (de Sitter static patch): dE = −T_dS dS_dS  [Gibbons-Hawking
                       1977; the minus sign is the de Sitter convention — opposite to a
                       black-hole horizon, because the cosmological horizon is the
                       observer's outer boundary.]

    Substitute (Defs 2,3 into Def 4, no simplification):
        S_dS = [4π (√(3/Λ))²] / (4G) = [4π · (3/Λ)] / (4G)

    Simplify (one step per line):
        S_dS = (12π/Λ) / (4G)
        S_dS = 3π / (G Λ)                       [Sage-MCP verified: 3*pi/(G*Lambda)]
        dS_dS/dΛ = −3π / (G Λ²)                 [Sage-MCP verified: -3*pi/(G*Lambda^2)]

    Direction (read off the canonical form):
        dS_dS/dΛ = −3π/(GΛ²) < 0  (G,Λ > 0)  ⇒  S_dS is strictly DECREASING in Λ
        ⇒ S_dS INCREASES as Λ (∝ a₀) DECREASES (horizon grows as vacuum energy falls).
        In the first law dE = −T_dS dS_dS with T_dS>0: dE>0 ⇒ dS_dS<0 ⇒ the de Sitter
        minus sign is REQUIRED (matter energy added to the static patch shrinks the
        cosmological horizon). The sign is the de Sitter convention, NOT a sign error.

    Conclusion (Volovik-tracking reduction, the gate's central test):
        H² = Λ/3  ⇒  ρ_vac(Λ) = 3H²/(8πG) = Λ/(8πG)   [Sage-MCP verified: Λ/(8πG)]
        Volovik tracking ρ_vac ∼ M_Pl² H²; under M_Pl² = 1/(8πG), H² = Λ/3:
          M_Pl² H² = Λ/(24πG)  ⇒  c_track = ρ_vac/(M_Pl²H²) = [Λ/(8πG)]/[Λ/(24πG)] = 3.
        The "∼" is an O(1) proportionality; c_track is the dimensionless coefficient the
        gate PINS (value depends on the M_Pl convention — reduced vs non-reduced — which
        the gate must state). The REDUCTION itself (first law → ρ_vac ∝ Λ ∝ a₀ H²) is an
        EXACT symbolic identity (reduction_residual = 0 to Sage QQ); only the dimensionless
        c_track coefficient carries the convention dependence. [Mnemonic-vs-exact discipline,
        math-scripts.md: report the Sage-exact c_track, do NOT publish "∼" as "=".]

PASS_meaning: "The a₀-channel de Sitter first law dE=−T_dS dS_dS reduces EXACTLY (residual ≤ 1e-12) to ρ_vac ∝ Λ ∝ a₀ H², matching the Volovik tracking law up to a convention-stated dimensionless c_track. Does NOT by itself derive a(t) — it relocates the clock to a tractable channel."
FAIL_meaning: "The a₀ first law does NOT reduce to ρ_vac ∝ Λ (reduction_residual > 1e-12). Solution-space consequence: the de Sitter horizon thermodynamics of the a₀ channel is NOT the Volovik tracking law; the C2 clock-location fork stays open and the a₀-channel-clock corridor is closed. Informative — eliminates the seed's proposed unification."
INFO_meaning: "The reduction holds symbolically (ρ_vac ∝ Λ) but c_track carries an unresolved convention/normalization ambiguity (the M_Pl convention or the a₀-to-Λ proportionality constant is not uniquely pinned). Structural-form unification holds; the numerical clock coefficient is HELD pending a convention pin. Maps to the rank-1 NNU §VII.BS one-imported-scale reading at the a₀ layer."

    - "computations/investigation-4/inv4_w3_de_sitter_clock_tracking.npz"

The workshop converts the recurring HELD-Level-3 string (§VII.AU, §VII.CB, S109) into a predictive wall + a decisive forward gate."

    its finite-L Level-3 magnitude anchor CONVERGES (admits a continuum L→∞ target) or
    DIVERGES (monotone-increasing, no target — the regime-BREAKDOWN signature of

          dispatch it directly.
  context: |

    regulator-invariant) while the Level-3 magnitude anchor diverges. Adjudication rule: the
    workshop produces a STRUCTURAL VERDICT — a single candidate theorem ("Level-3 magnitude
    converges iff …") that converts the string of per-instance HELD rows into a predictive

    item (Investigating-Workshops.md): two competing readings of a substrate-physics
    structural pattern, cross-rebuttal essential, resolution is a derivation producing a new

- **INV4-W3-1 PASS** (a₀ first law reduces to Volovik tracking, c_track convention-pinned) → carry-forward to a session-track gate that promotes the a₀-clock relation (the result is investigation-track and NOT yet permanent — `gate-verdicts.md §"Investigation-Track Canonical Path"` track-local boundary: migrate, do not merely cite). The complementarity with INV4-W2-2 (Raychaudhuri a₂/invariant reading) becomes the explicit seed of a FUTURE a₀-vs-a₂ clock-location workshop (NOT planned this round).
- **INV4-W3-1 INFO** (reduction holds, c_track convention-ambiguous) → carry-forward a convention-pinning compute (which M_Pl convention / a₀-to-Λ proportionality the framework canonically adopts) before any session-promotion.

- **INV4-W3-2 LANDED with a unified criterion** (sub-question c pre-registers a decisive gate) → the decisive forward gate is the leading carry-forward to the next session's plan (it converts the HELD-Level-3 string into a wall once it runs). The candidate theorem is a STAGE-0 workshop-internal artifact → STAGE-1-CANDIDATE registration is a SEPARATE session-track gate (joint-theorem-promotion.md 4-stage pathway; the two distinct-axis agents are the Stage-0 authors, NOT the Stage-2 cross-reviewers).
- **INV4-W3-2 LANDED as PARTIAL (INFO)** (readings documented, not converged) → the documented (a)/(b) tension is the carry-forward; the decisive discriminating gate is itself the next-session compute item.
- **INV4-W3-2 NOT-LANDED** → `/rclab-coordinate` re-dispatch (artifact-existence closure failure, NOT a substrate-physics verdict).
